proposition: Ibn Turka, Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī and their Isfahan circle formed the eastern arm of a Neo-Ikhwān al-Ṣafāʾ network centred on Akhlāṭī in Cairo and reaching Ottoman lands through Bedreddīn, Bisṭāmī and Fanārī (Melvin-Koushki's proposal, following Binbaş).

mediation.note: a hypothesis, stated as such ('appears to have been')
